import LightEFTSpanners
import LightEFTSpanners.StoredAssignmentDrawBank
import LightEFTSpanners.StoredAssignmentDrawList
import LightEFTSpanners.StoredCanonicalAssignmentOutput
import LightEFTSpanners.StoredCanonicalForestGuarantee
import Lean.Util.CollectAxioms
import Lean.Util.FoldConsts
set_option stderrAsMessages false
#eval IO.eprintln "LIGHT_CANONICAL_DRAW_BANK_AUDIT_IMPORTED"
open Lean in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let modules := env.allImportedModuleNames
  let allowed : Array Name := #[`propext, `Classical.choice, `Quot.sound]
  let wanted : Array Name := #[`LightEFTSpanners.StoredAssignmentDrawBank,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredAssignmentDrawList,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredCanonicalAssignmentOutput,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredCanonicalForestGuarantee]
  let wantedSet : NameSet := wanted.foldl (fun seen name => seen.insert name) {}
  let mut counts : NameMap Nat := {}
  let mut count : Nat := 0
  for (name, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    if let some idx := env.getModuleIdxFor? name then
      let module := modules[idx.toNat]!
      if wantedSet.contains module then
        counts := counts.insert module ((counts.find? module).getD 0+1)
        count := count+1
        if ci.isUnsafe then throwError "Unsafe stored record declaration: {name}"
        for ax in ← Lean.collectAxioms name do
          unless allowed.contains ax do throwError "Forbidden stored record axiom: {name}: {ax}"
  for module in wanted do
    let found := (counts.find? module).getD 0
    if found == 0 then throwError "No declarations audited for {module}"
    logInfo m!"LIGHT_CANONICAL_DRAW_BANK_MODULE_AUDIT passed: {module}; {found} declarations"
  logInfo m!"LIGHT_CANONICAL_DRAW_BANK_DECLARATION_AUDIT passed: {count} declarations"
  for root in #[`LightEFTSpanners.StoredForestCandidates.setEdges_represents,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredForestCandidates.componentId_injective,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredDrawLookup.typedValue_indexed,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredForestCandidates.assignmentBank_represents,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredForestCandidates.execute_canonical_assignment,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredForestCandidates.graphEdges_edgeSet,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredForestCandidates.exists_canonical_forest_high_probability] do
    IO.eprintln s!"LIGHT_CANONICAL_DRAW_BANK_CLOSURE_BEGIN {root}"
    let mut todo := #[root]
    let mut seen : NameSet := {}
    let mut axioms : NameSet := {}
    while !todo.isEmpty do
      let name := todo.back!
      todo := todo.pop
      unless seen.contains name do
        seen := seen.insert name
        let some ci := env.find? name | throwError "Missing closure constant: {name}"
        if ci.isUnsafe then throwError "Unsafe closure constant: {root}: {name}"
        match ci with
        | .axiomInfo _ =>
          axioms := axioms.insert name
          unless allowed.contains name do throwError "Forbidden closure axiom: {root}: {name}"
        | _ => pure ()
        for dep in ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet.toList do
          unless seen.contains dep do todo := todo.push dep
    logInfo m!"LIGHT_CANONICAL_DRAW_BANK_TYPE_BODY_CLOSURE passed: {root}; {seen.toList.length} constants; axioms {axioms.toList}"

weighted-law/StoredOriginalWeightLawSafe.content:
import LightEFTSpanners
import LightEFTSpanners.StoredOriginalWeightRepresentation
import LightEFTSpanners.StoredOriginalWeightedGuarantee
import LightEFTSpanners.StoredOriginalWeightedOutput
import Lean.Util.CollectAxioms
import Lean.Util.FoldConsts
set_option stderrAsMessages false
#eval IO.eprintln "LIGHT_ORIGINAL_WEIGHT_LAW_AUDIT_IMPORTED"
open Lean in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let modules := env.allImportedModuleNames
  let allowed : Array Name := #[`propext, `Classical.choice, `Quot.sound]
  let wanted : Array Name := #[`LightEFTSpanners.StoredOriginalWeightRepresentation,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredOriginalWeightedGuarantee,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredOriginalWeightedOutput]
  let wantedSet : NameSet := wanted.foldl (fun seen name => seen.insert name) {}
  let mut counts : NameMap Nat := {}
  let mut count : Nat := 0
  for (name, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    if let some idx := env.getModuleIdxFor? name then
      let module := modules[idx.toNat]!
      if wantedSet.contains module then
        counts := counts.insert module ((counts.find? module).getD 0+1)
        count := count+1
        if ci.isUnsafe then throwError "Unsafe stored record declaration: {name}"
        for ax in ← Lean.collectAxioms name do
          unless allowed.contains ax do throwError "Forbidden stored record axiom: {name}: {ax}"
  for module in wanted do
    let found := (counts.find? module).getD 0
    if found == 0 then throwError "No declarations audited for {module}"
    logInfo m!"LIGHT_ORIGINAL_WEIGHT_LAW_MODULE_AUDIT passed: {module}; {found} declarations"
  logInfo m!"LIGHT_ORIGINAL_WEIGHT_LAW_DECLARATION_AUDIT passed: {count} declarations"
  for root in #[`LightEFTSpanners.StoredOriginalWeightLookup.weight_map_out,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredOriginalWeightLookup.originalBank_represents,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredWeightedForestCandidates.execute_original_weights,
    `LightEFTSpanners.StoredForestCandidates.exists_original_weight_forest_high_probability] do
    IO.eprintln s!"LIGHT_ORIGINAL_WEIGHT_LAW_CLOSURE_BEGIN {root}"
    let mut todo := #[root]
    let mut seen : NameSet := {}
    let mut axioms : NameSet := {}
    while !todo.isEmpty do
      let name := todo.back!
      todo := todo.pop
      unless seen.contains name do
        seen := seen.insert name
        let some ci := env.find? name | throwError "Missing closure constant: {name}"
        if ci.isUnsafe then throwError "Unsafe closure constant: {root}: {name}"
        match ci with
        | .axiomInfo _ =>
          axioms := axioms.insert name
          unless allowed.contains name do throwError "Forbidden closure axiom: {root}: {name}"
        | _ => pure ()
        for dep in ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet.toList do
          unless seen.contains dep do todo := todo.push dep
    logInfo m!"LIGHT_ORIGINAL_WEIGHT_LAW_TYPE_BODY_CLOSURE passed: {root}; {seen.toList.length} constants; axioms {axioms.toList}"

LightManifestAudit.lean.content:
import LightEFTSpanners
import Lean.Util.CollectAxioms

/-! Audit all declarations by defining module, including private/generated
ones and declarations whose namespace differs from their defining module. -/
open Lean in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let moduleNames := env.allImportedModuleNames
  let allowed : Array Name := #[`propext, `Classical.choice, `Quot.sound]
  for root in #[`LightEFTSpanners] do
    let mut count : Nat := 0
    let mut definingModules : NameSet := {}
    for (name, _) in env.constants.toList do
      let fromProject := match env.getModuleIdxFor? name with
        | some idx => match moduleNames[idx.toNat]? with
          | some moduleName => root.isPrefixOf moduleName
          | none => false
        | none => false
      if fromProject then
        if let some idx := env.getModuleIdxFor? name then
          definingModules := definingModules.insert moduleNames[idx.toNat]!
        count := count + 1
        let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms name
        for ax in axioms do
          unless allowed.contains ax do
            throwError "Disallowed axiom {ax} in {name}"
    logInfo m!"Defining modules audited: {definingModules.toList.length}"
    if count == 0 then
      throwError "No declarations found for {root}; the audit did not run"
    logInfo m!"Axiom audit passed: {count} declarations defined in {root} modules; allowed axioms: {allowed}"
